column7: Single-process half of #4533 on SQLite: a hook removes the grantee's project grants on the transaction handle after GrantSecretACL's membership pre-check and before the ACL upsert; the storage re-check after the write refuses, the transaction rolls back (no ACL row, membership removal rolled back with it) and core answers the same ErrInvalidSecretACLRequest a serial remove-then-grant gets. Red before the fix (grant succeeded, row present). Store-level: TestLocalACL_RefusesNonMemberGrantee, TestLocalACL_AcceptsGroupOnlyMemberGrantee (the definition is re-asked, not narrowed)
